topic: How regular massage can support recovery after a busy work week
angle: Explain the benefit in simple, non-medical language for local clients who sit at a desk all day.

instagram.caption: A long week can leave your shoulders, neck, and back feeling heavy. A focused massage session gives your body a moment to reset, release everyday tension, and feel easier again. If your week has been full, book a time that helps you slow down.
